scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @antin-os/shared lint && pnpm --filter @antin-os/api-client lint && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter api lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @antin-os/shared lint && pnpm --filter @antin-os/api-client lint && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.test:commit: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.test:final: pnpm test:commit && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm exec openspec validate --all --strict
